title: Kingdom Picture Parade
hook: Read the kingdom like a map, not a ranking.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: bright 3D fairy-tale storybook, gentle castles magic and friendly creatures, safe whimsical scenes; visual identity: Kingdom Picture Parade

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child reading a fictional kingdom critically
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Kingdom Picture Parade a place-and-symbol literacy song: crown, throne, banner, village, tower, bridge, forest, island and court roles show how stories represent authority and geography without claiming monarchy is natural or magical.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child reads a fictional kingdom map and distinguishes symbols of office from actual ability or goodness.
